description: HY-Motion 1.0 (1.0B parameters): a flow-matching diffusion transformer that turns a text prompt into a human motion for the 52-joint SMPL-H-layout wooden skeleton, with the 22 body joints generated and the hand joints held at the SMPL-H mean pose. This is the full model, not Lite; its text encoders are Qwen3-8B and CLIP ViT-L/14, catalogued separately. Released under the Tencent HY-Motion 1.0 Community License, which excludes the European Union, the United Kingdom and South Korea (information only).
